text:
sara: Heads-up — about to toggle the `surgical_cohort` feature flag to 20% for model v2.1 during the 21:00 UTC change window. Doing a slow ramp: 5m soak per step. Deploy bot will start in ~2m.
kevin: SG. Do we pin traffic anywhere? want to avoid mixed-weight routing with legacy v2.0.
sara: Yes — pin cohorts 7-10 to v2.1 for 30m, others ramp from 0 -> 20%.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: initiating feature-flag change `surgical_cohort` -> 20% (target model v2.1). run id db5a0. ETA: started.
mike: Quick rollback plan: immediate unpin + set flag to 0% if latency spikes. keep that command handy.
eva: Agreed. I'll monitor latency and 5xx traces. runbook link: /runbooks/ff-rollback (also pinned in the release notes).
sara: Rollback command prepared:```
deploy-bot toggle --flag surgical_cohort --value 0 --reason "rollback - latency spike" --run-id db5a0
```
kevin: :thumbsup: Also enable deploy-bot safety-window=10m so it won't progress past the next step without manual ack.
ops-bot: ops-bot: safety-window set to 10m for run db5a0 (applied).
mike: Initial metrics after step: p95 latency +2ms, QPS stable, no error spike.
eva: Sampling traces — error rate 0.02% (within normal). will continue to next step in 5m unless thresholds hit.
sara: Note — earlier we discussed 50% later, but let's be conservative: 20% -> 40% with 10m soak then evaluate for pin/unpin.
kevin: Sounds good. stick to slow ramp: keep cohorts pinned until after second soak.
sara: Updating release notes: https://redwood/internal/releases/rel-2.1-surgical (adding run id db5a0 & rollout plan).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: completed step 1 -> 20% for `surgical_cohort`. scheduled next check at 1754243024.
mike: Copy. I'll also watch cost delta — embeddings RPCs bumped slightly.
eva: Alerts configured: post to #incidents if 5xx > 0.5% or p95 increases by >50ms.
sara: :white_check_mark: Closing loop here — if any threshold breaches, execute rollback command above and ping @oncall.
kevin: Recording post-deploy anchors in the release doc (latency, 5xx, cost). good run so far. :rocket:
